info.title: OneLoaf core-api API
info.description: Part of OneLoaf, a web application for managing bread recipes and planning home baking. Authenticate with a bearer token from POST /api/v1/auth/login of the Core API. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json) with a correlationId; JSON uses camelCase and enums are snake_case strings. Guides: docs/api in the repository.

get.description: Missing prices, empty recipes, overdue batches and starters of the current user.

post.summary: Publish a recipe to the library
post.description: US-39. Publishes an immutable snapshot of the effective recipe; later edits of the recipe do not change it.
US-19. Splits the loaves into rounds within the oven capacity of the kitchen settings (422 when not set); recipes with the same oven time share a round.
US-01. Creates the user and an empty workspace (kitchen settings with defaults).

post.summary: Log in and get an access token
post.description: US-02. Returns an RS256 JWT and sets the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie. Unknown e-mail and wrong password give the same 401.

post.summary: Exchange the refresh token cookie for a new access token
post.description: US-02. The cookie is replaced by the next token of the same sign-in (rotation). 401 for a missing, expired or revoked token; a token that was already exchanged revokes the whole sign-in.
US-02. Revokes the refresh tokens of this sign-in and removes the cookie; the access token expires by itself and the client discards it.

delete.summary: Delete the current account and all its data
delete.description: US-04. Requires the current password; removes the whole workspace by cascade.

parameters.description: Only this status: planned, in_progress, done or cancelled.

post.summary: Create a batch and build its plan
post.description: US-20. Stages, kneading cycles, starter amounts, reminders, ready window and cost from sp_build_batch_plan; the ingredients with kept stock are taken from the stock.

post.summary: Plan a batch without saving it
post.description: US-34. Same input as create; the plan is built by the database and rolled back. Ids are empty. The stock check tells which ingredients are missing and what the stock is enough for.

get.summary: Get a batch with items and stages

put.description: US-20. Only a batch that has not started can be changed (409 otherwise).

delete.description: A running batch cannot be deleted (409). The history record of a completed batch stays. ingredientsUsed=false returns the ingredients the batch took to the stock.

post.description: Scheduled reminders of the batch are cancelled. ingredientsUsed=false returns the ingredients the batch took to the stock; the default keeps them consumed.
US-31. The database creates the history record with the cost on the bake date.

post.summary: Save how the batch was baked as a recipe variant
post.description: US-25. Finished stages take their measured duration, changed or extended stages their batch durations; everything else is inherited. 422 when the batch followed the recipe.

get.summary: Merged kneads of the same dough

post.description: US-23. Stores the actual start; the first started stage moves the batch to in_progress.

post.summary: Extend a stage by N minutes
post.description: US-24. Following stages, reminders and the ready window shift (sp_extend_batch_stage).

patch.summary: Change the planned durations for this batch only

post.summary: Restore the durations of the recipe stage

get.description: US-27, US-28, US-30. Last feeding, next feeding and expected peak.

delete.description: US-27. Batches keep their items without it.

post.description: US-28, US-29, US-30. The next feeding, the peak and the feeding reminder are set by the database.

US-40. Anonymous. Snapshot, author name, comment and reaction counts. Unpublished ones are visible only to the author.

get.description: Anonymous. The photo of the recipe the publication was made from; 404 without a photo or for a hidden publication.
US-41. Anonymous. Oldest first; paged.

delete.description: US-41. Soft remove; another user's comment gives 404.

put.description: US-41. like, love or want_to_bake; replaces the previous one.

post.summary: Copy a published recipe into the own workspace
post.description: US-42. Creates an independent recipe. The optional body says, per ingredient of the published recipe, which own ingredient to use instead (same unit) or how much of a new one is on the shelf; without a choice an ingredient is matched to the own catalog by name or created.

post.summary: Report a publication or a comment
post.description: LR-11. With commentId the comment is reported, otherwise the publication.

get.description: LR-11. Administrators only; open reports by default, oldest first. Requires the admin role.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Status filter: open (default), resolved or rejected.

post.description: LR-11. remove hides the reported comment or removes the publication with the reason; reject keeps it. 409 when already decided. Requires the admin role.
LR-11. The publication cannot be published again. Requires the admin role.
